address: Mövenpick Hotel Tahlia, 8749 Hail Street, Al Andalus, Jeddah, 23326, Saudi Arabia
bio: An outpost of Rasoi by Vineet, this restaurant is located on the ground floor of the Mövenpick Hotel Tahlia. A bright and colourful interior awaits and we recommend sitting at one of the booths for a cosy evening. The amiable team are happy to serve all your favourite Indian dishes, which come with assorted regional flavours. A must-order is the juicy and subtly spiced Malai lobster as a main, while saffron rasmalai is great way to end your meal.
